name: 山野草平取建頼母子
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, pp. 16–18, 第六條, 第十八條–第二十條, 追加
notes: CONFIRMED 2026-10-22 (records/RULINGS-residual-default-2026-10-22.md, ruling 3): stays .NR. A general amendment or 必要ノ事項 clause is not `deferred`; counting it would make RD-test=deferred track GV1=collective. Note as first coded: Silent beyond the drawn member's own security. A payout does create a debt (第五條 子方ノ返掛ハ毎會金參拾圓ニ利子金參圓ヲ附シ將來返掛スルモノトス; 第四條 for the 發起人), so the cell applies and is not .NA. The security is 抵當 plus 保證人貳名 (第六條), which is RB3's ground (rule 1). Nothing names a bearer once 抵當 and 保證人 fail. Three clauses could be mistaken for one and are not: (i) 第十九條 後取者ニシテ掛金ノ不埒ノ節ハ除名ノ上掛金捨ノ事 is an unwon member's default, CN3's ground under rule 5; (ii) 第十八條 此賴母子滿會前ヨリ利子相增シ高金壹千拾圓ヲ取除ケ殘リノ金員ハ親ヲ除キ子方惣割ノ事 divides a SURPLUS among the 子方, not a loss; (iii) 第二十條 右規約將來故障事項差起リタル時ハ協議ノ上之ヲ變更スルコトヲ得 is a general amendment power for any 故障, not an instruction that the members will decide who bears an unpaid residue. ALTERNATIVE READING, stated fairly: 第二十條 could be read as `deferred`, since a drawn member's unpaid residue is plainly a 故障事項 and the remedy is 協議. Rejected because `deferred` asks whether the instrument says the members will decide THIS question, and a general amendment clause says only that the rules can be changed. If the maintainer reads general 協議 clauses as `deferred`, this cell moves.

name: 山野草平取建頼母子
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, pp. 16–17, 第六條–第七條
notes: Property and surety together. 第六條 返掛證書ハ普通賴母子證書ニシテ抵當ハ左ノ三種トシ、保證人貳名相立テ會日ノ五日前惣代人ニ照會シ賴母子惣代人ニ宛テタル證書ヲ認メ登記濟ノモノタルコト, the three 抵當品 being 一、田地ナレバ小作米參石貳斗カ地價ナレバ二掛ケトス / 一、公債證書ナレバ返掛高ノ七掛トス / 一、山林、畑、宅地其他ハ協議ニ附スベシ, with 但シ該抵當品書入ニ就テハ年ヲ經ルニ從ヒ協議ノ上變更スル事ヲ得. Registration is required (登記濟ノモノ), and 第七條 puts the 登記所 fee (金五拾錢) on the 負債主. `mixed` here carries both mixtures the ko_mitarai_gin_1805 note warns of: several kinds of property (land, public bonds, forest/fields/house-plots) AND property plus two sureties.

name: 山野草平取建頼母子
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, pp. 16–18, 第一條–第二十條, 追加
notes: No rule distributes an unmet loss. The only distribution rule is 第十八條 此賴母子滿會前ヨリ利子相增シ高金壹千拾圓ヲ取除ケ殘リノ金員ハ親ヲ除キ子方惣割ノ事, which divides an accumulated SURPLUS among the 子方 excluding the 親; reading it as the loss rule would turn a surplus clause into a loss clause. Silence, not absence.

name: 山野草平取建頼母子
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, pp. 16–17, 第五條–第七條
notes: ADJUDICATED 2026-10-22 (records/RULINGS-residual-default-2026-10-22.md, ruling 2): 1 -> .NR. For a kō, LS3 is 1 by either of two routes: the association route (a member answers for other members' obligations) or the debtor route (a drawer is expressly liable beyond his pledge with his person or whole estate; precedents sea_loan LS3=1, bodemerij_amsterdam LS3=1). Here the drawer's pledge and/or sureties secure his own agreed repayment; no clause makes him liable beyond the pledge with his person or estate, and no clause makes a member answer for another's debt. A pledge or surety alone is .NR on the general question, not 1 and not 0 (bodemerij_amsterdam note); 0 would need a clause confining liability to the pledge (bottomry). The clauses read are those quoted in the note as first coded: Coded on HOUSE PRACTICE, and the definition strains under it. Once he draws, a 子方 owes 返掛 of 參拾圓 plus 利子金參圓 a meeting (第五條), secured by registered 抵當 and 保證人貳名 (第六條 返掛證書ハ普通賴母子證書ニシテ抵當ハ左ノ三種トシ、保證人貳名相立テ…登記濟ノモノタルコト). His land or bonds answer for the debt, which is how ko_mitarai_mujin_1773 and ko_mitarai_hanei_1840 were coded LS3=1 ('Property answering for the debt is exposure beyond what has been paid in'). Against it: the definition says beyond what he has contributed OR AGREED TO CONTRIBUTE, and the 返掛 is exactly what he agreed to contribute; on that reading the cell is .NR, because no clause exposes him beyond his own 返掛. Medium and analyst-imposed for that reason; the tension is raised in answer 5.

name: 山野草平取建頼母子

Lateness is fined: 第十條 掛金ハ各自持寄ニシテ午後三時ヲ經過スルトキハ會席妨料トシテ金參拾錢ヲ出スベシ. Not P: unlike ko_usui_bango_1822, the sanction is not limited to forfeiture of the draw.

name: 山野草平取建頼母子
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, pp. 17–18, 第十條, 第十二條, 第十五條–第十七條, 第二十條
notes: Officers are chosen by and from the whole membership and the open questions go to 協議. 第十五條 本會ヲ整理スル爲メ役員貳名ヲ置ク、但シ惣會員中ヨリ互選セルモノヲ惣代人トシ後取中ヨリ互選セルモノヲ證書保管人トス (footnote 5: 惣會員は總會員で講員一同のこと); penalty money 協議ノ上處分スルモノトス (第十條 但書); the rules themselves 協議ノ上之ヲ變更スルコトヲ得 (第二十條); the 昭和六年 suspension was 協議ノ結果 (追加). The 發起人 (= 講親, footnote 3) has only the duty of notice (第十一條) and his own 返掛 (第四條); the 惣代人 has discretion over a week's postponement (第十二條). ALTERNATIVE: house practice codes .NR where a beneficiary-convener sits beside officers (ko_mochiyori_yutsu_1876, ko_usui_bango_1822). Not followed here because these rules give the convener no decision power over the fund and vest it in elected officers and 協議. Medium: 協議 never names its participants.

name: 昭和講
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, p. 19, 講則 items 6, 7, 8
notes: The rule names a group fixed in advance by the rules and liable by belonging. 講則 item 6: 一、時間內掛金不足ノ際ハ講クビリヨリ立替ヘルコト / 但シ猿田一クビリ、高六上組一クビリ、高六下組一クビリト定ム. The クビリ are the three 部落 of the kō, so liability attaches by residence, not by signature, which is the rule-1 test for `standing-subgroup`. Why it reaches a DRAWN member's default: item 7 provides separately for the 子 (footnote 4: 子は未取者), 一、子ノ時間內掛金不足ノ際抽籤除ケトス, so item 6 is the provision that covers a 既取者's unpaid 返掛. Three reasons for medium rather than high: (i) item 6 says 立替ヘル, to advance, and names no further bearer, so the クビリ is the last bearer the instrument NAMES (rule 2) but the text does not say it bears the loss finally rather than advancing it against recovery; (ii) item 6 does not say in words that the defaulter's OWN クビリ advances, although dividing the kō into three クビリ makes no sense otherwise; (iii) the order against the drawer's own security (the 連帶借用證書 of item 8) is not stated: item 6 operates at the meeting, before any security could be realised. The 解說's stronger reading (既取者 … 返掛を怠り … 各クビリの講員は、連帶してその責に任ずる) agrees but is the ministry's gloss, not the rule, and is not counted as a second witness.

name: 昭和講
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, p. 19, 講則 item 8
notes: 講則 item 8: 一、講取當ノ者ハ連帶借用證書ヲ支配人ニ差入ルルコト. A 連帶借用證書 has joint obligors by definition, so a co-signer stands behind the drawer; no property is named. Medium because the rule does not say who the co-obligors are. If they are the members of the drawer's クビリ (as the 解說's gloss 講クビリといふ場合連帶保證 … の意味に用ひられて would suggest), then the line between signing (RB3) and belonging (RD-test) is blurred in this kō: see answer 4. Coded on the text, which speaks of a bond, not of the クビリ.

name: 昭和講
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, p. 19, 講則 items 1–15
notes: Who bears the shortfall is stated (講則 item 6, the クビリ); how it is divided among the クビリ's members is not. 立替ヘル says nothing on pro-rata, equal or capped shares. The 解說's 連帶して is joint liability, which is not one of LS1's values and in any case is the ministry's gloss. Silence on the division.

name: 昭和講
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, p. 19, 講則 items 6, 8
notes: A member can be made to pay beyond his own contribution: through his クビリ, for another member's shortfall (講則 item 6 一、時間內掛金不足ノ際ハ講クビリヨリ立替ヘルコト, with the three クビリ fixed by its 但書), and, once he has drawn, on a 連帶借用證書 (item 8). This is exposure for OTHERS' obligations, so it does not depend on the house-practice reading noted at 第六講. Medium: 立替ヘル is an advance and the rule does not say how it falls on individual members of the クビリ.

name: 昭和講
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, p. 19, 講則 items 6, 7, 8
notes: CONFIRMED 2026-10-22 (records/RULINGS-residual-default-2026-10-22.md, ruling 1): stays 1; under ruling 1 a required bond is compulsion, so the inconsistency with kō 18 and 27 reported in the coding notes (answer 5.1) is resolved by moving those cells, not these. Note as first coded: Drawn members sign a 連帶借用證書 to the 支配人 (講則 item 8 一、講取當ノ者ハ連帶借用證書ヲ支配人ニ差入ルルコト), which is a debt instrument enforceable against them and their co-obligors, and their shortfall at a meeting is covered by their クビリ (item 6). Unwon members (rule 5, recorded here): 一、子ノ時間內掛金不足ノ際抽籤除ケトス (item 7), exclusion from that round's lot, which alone would be the P of ko_usui_bango_1822. The value rests on the drawn side. Medium because no clause speaks of suit or distraint in words.

name: 昭和講
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, p. 19, 講則 items 1–15
notes: Five 支配人 (footnote 1: 支配人は世話人のこと) paid 一回ニ付金一圓 (items 2–3) receive the drawers' bonds (item 8) and the notice of a member's removal from the village (item 13). The rules do not say how the 支配人 are chosen, and no clause gives decision over the fund to an assembly, an elder or an outside body. Silence on the locus of decision.

name: 春山夏助長壽講
place_as_printed: 靜岡縣引佐郡井伊谷村
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, pp. 30–31, 第三條, 第六條
notes: The 世話人 answer for the 講主's default itself. 第三條: 初回ノ掛金ハ講主之ヲ申受ケ直チニ講主及講主引受人連帶ノ借用證書ヲ世話人ヘ提出シ、期日ニハ無相違掛金致シ屹度義務ヲ相果シ可申萬一之場合ハ世話人ニ於テ辨濟到シ決シテ加入者ニ對シ御迷惑相懸申間敷事 (辨濟到シ as printed). The 講主 (footnote 1: 講親) holds one of the 二十口 and takes the first pot, so he is a drawn member; his own security is the joint bond with his 引受人 (footnote 3: 講親の保證人), which is RB3's ground; beyond it the clause names the 世話人, and expressly shields the 加入者. This is liability for the default, not for mishandling, so rule 3 does not apply. Medium for one reason that matters: the clause covers the 講主 only. For the other drawers (落札シタル者) 第六條 requires 世話人ニ於テ充分ナルモノト認ムル抵當權 before the pot is handed over and names no bearer if it fails. Rule 2 has me code the last bearer the instrument names, and the only one it names is the 世話人; but the value describes the convener's default, not every drawer's. See answer 4: RD-test has one cell where this kō has two regimes. ALTERNATIVE: .NR, on the ground that the question is about 'a member' generally and the instrument is silent for 十九 of the 二十口.

name: 春山夏助長壽講
place_as_printed: 靜岡縣引佐郡井伊谷村
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, pp. 30–31, 第三條, 第六條
notes: Surety for the convener, property for the other drawers. 講主: 講主及講主引受人連帶ノ借用證書 (第三條; footnote 3 講主引受人は講親の保證人). Other drawers: 本講ニ於テ落札シタル者ハ世話人ニ於テ充分ナルモノト認ムル抵當權ヲ取得シ以テ落札金ヲ引渡スモノトス (第六條), a hypothec whose object is not named. `mixed` because the instrument takes property and surety together, BUT not on the same drawer: no drawer gives both. That is a third sense of `mixed`, beside the two the ko_mitarai_gin_1805 note distinguishes. ALTERNATIVE: `surety`, coding only the fully specified clause, since the object of the 抵當權 is not named (the ko_meio_1498 objection). Rejected because a 抵當權 is property security whatever its object, and dropping 第六條 would describe one drawer out of twenty.

A pledge or surety alone is .NR on the general question, not 1 and not 0 (bodemerij_amsterdam note); 0 would need a clause confining liability to the pledge (bottomry). name: 春山夏助長壽講
place_as_printed: 靜岡縣引佐郡井伊谷村
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, pp. 30–31, 第三條, 第六條, signatories
notes: NO FITTING VALUE. Decision over the fund sits with the 世話人: they take and judge the drawers' security and hand over the pot (第六條 世話人ニ於テ充分ナルモノト認ムル抵當權ヲ取得シ以テ落札金ヲ引渡スモノトス) and they guarantee the 講主 (第三條). Nine or so 講事世話人 sign the rules beside the 講主 and his 引受人. Nothing says how they are chosen or that an assembly decides anything. A board of officers who are also guarantors of the convener is neither collective, nor elder-fixed, nor external-administered on the record; coded .NR as house practice does for named officers whose mandate is not described (ko_mitarai_hanei_1840, ko_horyuji_50kan).

name: 深井朝右衞門發起頼母子
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, pp. 33–34, 第拾條, 第拾壹條, 第拾五條, 賴母子金借用證書
notes: Silent beyond the drawer's own security, and the rules say where they send the silence. A payout creates a debt (第六條 次親ハ無利息元掛ノコト; the form 毎回金貳拾圓宛無相違返濟可致候), so the cell applies. The drawer's security is 入組人中ヨリ連帶保證人貳名 (第拾條), RB3's ground under rule 1 even though the guarantors must come from the membership: they are chosen for this loan and bind by signing. The form adds acceleration on default (萬一違約致候節ハ年賦方法ヲ解キ全部一時ニ請求セラルヽモ異議申間敷候), which is the defaulter's own liability (rule 4). 第拾壹條 (取當人前條ヲ履行セザルトキハ貳番札ヲ以テ取當者トス、入札ノ差金ハ違約者ヨリ辨償セシメ後取者ニ分配スルモノトス) is a winner who fails to complete, again the defaulter's own liability (rule 4). Beyond that: 第拾五條 右規約以外ノ事項ハ地方賴母子ノ慣例ニ從フモノトス. That is an express reference to local custom, not an instruction that the members will decide, so it is not `deferred`; and rule 6 forbids coding what custom or law would supply. .NR, with the reference to custom recorded because it is a different kind of silence from a rulebook that says nothing.

name: 深井朝右衞門發起頼母子
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, pp. 33–34, 第拾條, 賴母子金借用證書
notes: 第拾條 取當者決定シタルトキハ五日以內ニ入組人中ヨリ連帶保證人貳名ヲ立テ、末尾記載ノ書式ニ準ジ證書ヲ調製シ總代ニ差出シ受金スルコト、但シ連帶保證人ノ內壹名ハ入組外ニテモ總代ノ承認スル者ナレバ差支ヘナシ. The form confirms it: 爲後日連帶保證人貳名相立借用證書差出置候. No property is taken. Note that the 取建親 (發起親), who receives the first pot without bidding, is not said to give guarantors; 第拾條 speaks of the 取當者 chosen at a meeting.

name: 深井朝右衞門發起頼母子
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, pp. 33–34, 第一條–第拾五條
notes: No rule distributes an unmet loss. The distribution clauses all divide gains: 入札棄金ハ後取者ノ所得トス (第八條), the defaulting winner's 差金 後取者ニ分配スル (第拾壹條), 延滯利息ハ取當者ノ所得トス (第拾四條). 第拾五條 sends anything else to 地方賴母子ノ慣例, which is not a rule of this instrument.

name: 深井朝右衞門發起頼母子
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, pp. 33–34, 第拾條, 賴母子金借用證書
notes: Members are exposed for other members' debts. 第拾條 requires the drawer to find 入組人中ヨリ連帶保證人貳名 (one may be an outsider approved by the 總代), so at least one fellow member stands as joint and several guarantor for a draw that is not his. That is the ko_mochiyori_yutsu_1876 ground (sureties who undertake to discharge another's debt), not the weaker house-practice ground of a drawer's own property, so this cell does not carry the definitional doubt noted at 第六講.

name: 深井朝右衞門發起頼母子
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, pp. 33–34, 第拾條, 第拾四條, 賴母子金借用證書
notes: Sanctioned on both sides of the draw. 第拾四條 前取者ト後取者ヲ問ハス掛金ノ延滯ニ對シテ日步百圓ニ付四錢ノ延滯利息ヲ附スルコト. For the unwon member (rule 5, recorded here) that penalty interest is the only stated sanction. For the drawer: joint and several guarantors (第拾條) and acceleration of the whole debt on default (form: 萬一違約致候節ハ年賦方法ヲ解キ全部一時ニ請求セラルヽモ異議申間敷候).

name: 深井朝右衞門發起頼母子
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, pp. 33–34, 第二條, 第拾貳條, 第拾三條
notes: A 總代 runs the fund (第拾三條 總代ハ全般ノ整理ヲナシ諸證書及ビ帳簿ノ保管ヲ成シ併セテ金錢ノ取扱ヲ成スモノトス, with a 副總代), may convene in place of a dilatory 發起者 (第拾貳條), and approves an outside guarantor (第拾條). How the 總代 is chosen is not stated. The membership acts as a body only on transfer of a share (第二條 入組者全部ノ快諾アル時ハ此限リニ非ス), which is a decision over membership, not over the fund. None of collective, elder-fixed, external-administered is supported by what is written; silence on the locus.

name: 權田太郎兵衞發起頼母子
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, pp. 36–37, 第八條–第十四條, 第二十一條, 第二十二條
notes: CONFIRMED 2026-10-22 (records/RULINGS-residual-default-2026-10-22.md, ruling 3): stays .NR. A general amendment or 必要ノ事項 clause is not `deferred`; counting it would make RD-test=deferred track GV1=collective. Note as first coded: Silent beyond the drawer's own security. The security is 貳名以上ノ保證人並ニ擔保物件 (第八條), one guarantor 必ス入組人タルコト (第九條): guarantors chosen for this loan, so RB3's ground under rule 1 even though one must be a member. On arrears the instrument goes to the drawer's own pledge and stops: 第十四條 前取者掛金延滯貳拾日以上ニ及フトキハ擔保物件ノ處分ニ着手ス. 第十三條 (取當者…完全ナル證書ヲ調ヘサル時ハ落札權ヲ失シ臨時會ヲ開キ處分ス、其ノ費用及差損金ハ失權ノ負擔トス) puts the loss of a failed completion on the defaulter himself (rule 4). Two general clauses are not read as answers: 第二十一條 右規約ノ改正及必要ノ事項ハ參分ノ貳以上ノ同意ヲ以テ決ス is a general decision rule, not an instruction that the members will decide who bears an unpaid residue (the `deferred` reading is stated and rejected as at 第六講); 第二十二條 本規約以外ハ總テ地方賴母子ノ慣例ニ依ル sends the gap to custom, which rule 6 forbids me to code.

name: 權田太郎兵衞發起頼母子
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, p. 36, 第八條–第十一條; p. 37, 賴母子返掛借用證書
notes: Property and surety together, on the same drawer. 第八條 取當者ハ貳名以上ノ保證人並ニ擔保物件ヲ定メ證書作成ノ上金錢ヲ受領スヘシ; 第九條 保證人ハ一名ハ必ス入組人タルコトヲ要ス; 第十條 取當者債務擔保物件ハ有價證券、田畑、山林、宅地家屋ヲ左ノ各項ニ準シ提供スヘシ, with cover ratios (五分利以上ノ公債ハ債務額百圓ニ付額面八十圓以上; 田地ハ債務額百圓ニ對シ地價十圓以上) and, for other property, 正副總代及評價人ノ承認, houses to carry fire insurance, real property only 嘉川村、井關村所在ノモノ; 第十一條 top-up on a fall in value (增擔保ノ請求ニ應スヘシ). The form has 債務者 and two 連帶保證人 and a schedule of 擔保物件. `mixed` again carries both mixtures (several kinds of property, and property plus surety).

name: 權田太郎兵衞發起頼母子
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, pp. 35–37, 第一條–第二十二條
notes: No rule distributes an unmet loss. The one distribution clause divides a surplus: 第三條 但シ滿會ハ親ノ利ハ入組全員配當トス (footnote 4: 入組全員は加入者全員), the 講親's interest shared among all members at the end. A failed completion's 差損金 falls on the defaulter (第十三條). Silence.

name: 權田太郎兵衞發起頼母子
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, p. 36, 第八條–第九條; p. 37, 賴母子返掛借用證書
notes: A member must stand as guarantor for another's draw: 第九條 保證人ハ一名ハ必ス入組人タルコトヲ要ス, with 第八條's 貳名以上ノ保證人, and the form makes them 連帶保證人. A member is therefore exposed beyond his own contribution for a debt that is not his. The ko_mochiyori_yutsu_1876 ground; does not depend on the house-practice reading noted at 第六講.

name: 權田太郎兵衞發起頼母子
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, pp. 36–37, 第十二條–第十四條
notes: Sanctioned on both sides of the draw. 第十二條 會座ノ節掛金未納者ハ前取後取ヲ論セス百圓ニ付一日金五錢ヲ取當者ニ支拂フモノトス (footnote 7: 既取未取を論ぜずの意), which is the only stated sanction for an unwon member (rule 5, recorded here). Drawers: 第十四條 前取者掛金延滯貳拾日以上ニ及フトキハ擔保物件ノ處分ニ着手ス, plus guarantors (第八條–第九條).

name: 權田太郎兵衞發起頼母子
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, p. 37, 第十五條–第二十一條
notes: Rule change and 'necessary matters' are decided by a qualified majority: 第二十一條 右規約ノ改正及必要ノ事項ハ參分ノ貳以上ノ同意ヲ以テ決ス; a transfer of a share needs 役員及子方半數以上ノ承諾 (第二十條; footnote 9 子方はここでは講員の意). Officers (正副總代, 評價人貳名) keep the books and cash and appraise collateral (第十五條–第十八條) for four-year terms, 再選ヲ妨ケス (第十九條); how they are chosen is not stated. Medium: 第二十一條 does not say whose two-thirds, although the members are the only body it can mean, and 必要ノ事項 is the broadest grant in the rules. ALTERNATIVE: .NR on house practice for officer-run kō; rejected because the rules put a decision rule on the membership in words.

name: 山坂昇講
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, pp. 51–52, 講則 items 1–8
notes: Silent. A payout creates a debt (掛戾金, footnote 5 返掛金即ち償還金), so the cell applies. The drawer's security is 掛戾金ノ總額ニ對シ擔保ヲ提供シ尙相當ノ保證人一名 (item 7), RB3's ground. Nothing names a bearer beyond it. One fact that could be misread as `fund`: every pot pays 積立金及雜費 貳圓五拾錢 (item 8), so a reserve exists; but no clause applies it to a default, and coding `fund` would infer the reserve's purpose from its existence. The kō was wound up before 1936 (解說), which does not affect what the rules say.

name: 山坂昇講
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, p. 52, 講則 item 7
notes: 一、落札人ガ其取當金ヲ領收スルニハ掛戾金ノ總額ニ對シ擔保ヲ提供シ尙相當ノ保證人一名ヲ要ス. Security for the whole remaining debt AND a surety, on the same drawer. The object of the 擔保 is not named; `mixed` rests on the clause distinguishing 擔保 from 保證人 (尙), so the 擔保 is something other than a person. The 解說 says the 親 gave 抵當物件 like any other drawer; that is the ministry's statement, used only as confirmation that item 7 bound the 親 too.

name: 山坂昇講
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, pp. 51–52, 講則 items 1–8
notes: No rule distributes an unmet loss. Item 8 lists deductions from each pot (盛料, 割取, 銀座手當, 積立金及雜費), none of which is a loss allocation. Silence.

name: 山坂昇講
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, p. 52, 講則 item 7
notes: ADJUDICATED 2026-10-22 (records/RULINGS-residual-default-2026-10-22.md, ruling 2): 1 -> .NR. For a kō, LS3 is 1 by either of two routes: the association route (a member answers for other members' obligations) or the debtor route (a drawer is expressly liable beyond his pledge with his person or whole estate; precedents sea_loan LS3=1, bodemerij_amsterdam LS3=1). Here the drawer's pledge and/or sureties secure his own agreed repayment; no clause makes him liable beyond the pledge with his person or estate, and no clause makes a member answer for another's debt. A pledge or surety alone is .NR on the general question, not 1 and not 0 (bodemerij_amsterdam note); 0 would need a clause confining liability to the pledge (bottomry). The clauses read are those quoted in the note as first coded: Coded on house practice (ko_mitarai_mujin_1773, ko_mitarai_hanei_1840): the drawer's 擔保 and his 保證人 answer for 掛戾金ノ總額 (item 7). Same definitional objection as at 第六講: what is secured is the repayment he agreed to make, so on a strict reading of 'beyond what he has … agreed to contribute' this would be .NR. Whether the 保證人 must be a member is not stated, so the stronger ground (exposure for another's debt) is not available here.

name: 山坂昇講
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, pp. 51–52, 講則 items 1–8
notes: ADJUDICATED 2026-10-22 (records/RULINGS-residual-default-2026-10-22.md, ruling 1): .NR -> 1, medium. The rules require the drawer to give a bond or security for his repayment; a required bond or pledge is the rules' own instrument of compulsion, and the procedure of enforcement need not be restated for the cell to be 1. Medium because no consequence of non-payment is stated in words. Note as first coded: No consequence of non-payment is stated. Item 4 fixes a deadline (集金ハ正午迄ト定メ) without saying what follows if it is missed; item 7 takes 擔保 and a 保證人 from the drawer and says nothing on when or how they are called. House practice: ko_mitarai_mujin_1773 CN3=.NR on a pledge with no sanction clause; this is the same case. Unwon members (rule 5): nothing stated. ALTERNATIVE: 1, reading a surety and a pledge as instruments of compulsion by their nature; that is the reading on which the existing row and this cell would both move.

name: 山坂昇講
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, pp. 51–52, 講則 items 5, 8
notes: 一、本講ハ管理ノタメ三人ノ銀座ヲ選任シ手當ヲ支給ス (item 5; footnote 2 銀座とは世話人或は役員のこと), paid 銀座手當 from each pot (item 8). Who chooses them and who decides over the fund are not stated. Silence on the locus.

name: 共同信用講
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, p. 58, 會則 落札金預リ方法; 講金預リ證書
notes: Silent beyond the drawer's own security. The rules stop at the guarantors: 會則 一、落札金預リ方法 落札金預リ證劵ニハ抵當書入確實ナル保證人貳名以上ヲ要ス、然ル上ハ不動產ノ登記ヲ要セズ, and the form makes the guarantors pay first and regardless of the pledge: 若シ壹回タリトモ遲滯シ掛返シ出來難キ時ハ辨濟保證人ハ本人ニ成リ代リ右抵當事實有無ニ拘ラズ金額ノ預リ金辨濟可仕候. Guarantors chosen for this loan are RB3's ground (rule 1). No clause names anyone beyond them. The heading 共同信用講 and the ministry's class say nothing the rules say, and are not coded from (FRAMES.md). Applicability: payout creates a debt (掛返シ), so not .NA.

name: 共同信用講
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, p. 58, 會則 落札金預リ方法; 講金預リ證書
notes: Property and surety on the same drawer. 會則: 落札金預リ證劵ニハ抵當書入確實ナル保證人貳名以上ヲ要ス、然ル上ハ不動產ノ登記ヲ要セズ — the mortgage is written into the deposit certificate and registration of the real property is waived once two sound guarantors stand. The form names the pledge as real property (此ノ抵當 一、家屋一棟 間口 間 奧行 間, 所有者 何某) and calls the guarantors 辨濟保證人. Of note for RB3: the clause trades registration of the pledge against the guarantors' standing, and the form makes the guarantors answer 抵當事實有無ニ拘ラズ, so the surety, not the property, is the operative security.

name: 共同信用講
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, p. 58, 會則 items 1–7

name: 共同信用講
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, p. 58, 會則 落札金預リ方法; 講金預リ證書
notes: ADJUDICATED 2026-10-22 (records/RULINGS-residual-default-2026-10-22.md, ruling 2): 1 -> .NR. For a kō, LS3 is 1 by either of two routes: the association route (a member answers for other members' obligations) or the debtor route (a drawer is expressly liable beyond his pledge with his person or whole estate; precedents sea_loan LS3=1, bodemerij_amsterdam LS3=1). Here the drawer's pledge and/or sureties secure his own agreed repayment; no clause makes him liable beyond the pledge with his person or estate, and no clause makes a member answer for another's debt. A pledge or surety alone is .NR on the general question, not 1 and not 0 (bodemerij_amsterdam note); 0 would need a clause confining liability to the pledge (bottomry). The clauses read are those quoted in the note as first coded: Coded on house practice, as at 第六講: the drawer's house is pledged and his guarantors stand behind his 掛返シ (會則 落札金預リ方法; form 此ノ抵當 一、家屋一棟 … 辨濟保證人ハ本人ニ成リ代リ). The rules do not say the guarantors must be members, so the stronger ground (a member liable for another's debt) is not available. Definitional objection as at 第六講.

name: 共同信用講
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, p. 58, 會則 花割方法; 講金預リ證書
notes: Explicit consequences of non-payment on both sides of the draw. Any member who fails to bring his 掛金 on the day loses his 花割 refund: 立會當日掛金持參ハ勿論ナルモ萬一持參無キ方ヘハ花割ヲ戾サズ (會則 花割方法); this is the only stated sanction on an unwon member (rule 5, recorded here). A drawer's single missed payment calls his guarantors in his place: 若シ壹回タリトモ遲滯シ掛返シ出來難キ時ハ辨濟保證人ハ本人ニ成リ代リ右抵當事實有無ニ拘ラズ金額ノ預リ金辨濟可仕候 (form). The ko_mitarai_gin_1805 pattern, stated in words.

name: 共同信用講

name: 昭和御大典記念講
place_as_printed: 福岡縣築上郡東吉富村
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, pp. 62–63, 第十條, 第十一條, 第十三條–第十五條, 第十九條
notes: Silent beyond the drawer's own security. The drawer gives (イ) 理事ニ於テ身元確實ト認ムル二名以上ノ連帶證書 or (ロ) 理事ニ於テ適當ノ擔保ト認ムヘキモノヲ書入レ登記スルコト (第十條), RB3's ground. Four clauses that could be mistaken for an answer, and why each is not: (i) 第十九條 理事ハ故意又ハ重大ナル過失ニ依リ本講ニ損害ヲ及ホシタルトキハ連帶責任ヲ以テ賠償ノ責ニ任ス is officers' liability for misconduct only, which rule 3 sends to .NR, not `officers`; (ii) 第十四條 積立金ハ訴訟其他避クヘカラサル費用ノ外使用スルコトヲ得ス lets the reserve pay for litigation, which is the cost of pursuing a defaulter, not the defaulted sum; reading it as `fund` would turn a costs clause into a loss clause; (iii) 第十一條 (再入札ヲ行ヒ其間際金及臨時費用トシテ金拾圓ヲ差出サシムル…若シ之ヲ拒ムトキハ講員ノ資格ヲ失ヒ既掛込金ハ全部沒收スル) is the defaulter's own liability on a refused or uncompleted draw (rule 4); (iv) 第十五條 divides the surplus 殘餘金 among the 未取得者. Applicability: 掛戾金 (footnote 1) is a debt, so not .NA.

name: 昭和御大典記念講
place_as_printed: 福岡縣築上郡東吉富村
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, pp. 62–63, 第十條
notes: 第十條 落札人ハ左ノ各項ノ一ニ依ルニアラサレハ落札金ヲ受取ルコトヲ得ス (イ) 理事ニ於テ身元確實ト認ムル二名以上ノ連帶證書ヲ差出ス事 (ロ) 理事ニ於テ適當ノ擔保ト認ムヘキモノヲ書入レ登記スルコト. Surety OR registered property, at the drawer's choice: 各項ノ一. The vocabulary defines `mixed` as property and surety TOGETHER, which this is not; neither `surety` nor `real-estate` describes the arrangement either, and the object of the 擔保 is not named. Coded `mixed` at medium as the nearest value for an instrument that admits both, and raised in answer 4. ALTERNATIVE: .NR as 'no fitting value'.

place_as_printed: 福岡縣築上郡東吉富村

name: 昭和御大典記念講
place_as_printed: 福岡縣築上郡東吉富村
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, pp. 62–63, 第七條, 第十條
notes: Members stand jointly for other members' draws. The drawer may give 二名以上ノ連帶證書 (第十條イ), and the rules treat those 證人 as members: 第七條 落札者ニシテ前條該當者アルトキハ其證人ニ對シテハ花籤ノ抽籤權ヲ停止ス — a guarantor of a defaulting drawer loses his 花籤 right, which only members hold. A member is thus exposed beyond his own contribution for another's debt. Medium because (イ) is optional (the drawer may pledge property instead) and membership of the 證人 is inferred from 第七條, not stated.

name: 昭和御大典記念講
place_as_printed: 福岡縣築上郡東吉富村
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, pp. 62–63, 第六條, 第七條, 第十一條
notes: Sanctioned on both sides of the draw, in graded money penalties. 第六條 掛金、掛戾金ヲ時間內ニ差出サヾルトキハ、辨當料ノ交付並ニ花籤ノ抽籤權ヲ失ヒ、且ツ掛金延滯ニ對シ左ノ通リ違約金ヲ徵收スルモノトス 一、掛戾金ニ對シテハ 一口ニ付一日拾錢 一、掛金ニ對シテハ 同上 四錢. The unwon member's (rule 5) sanction is the 四錢 a day and the loss of 辨當料 and 花籤. A drawer's default also costs his guarantor (第七條). A winner who will not complete loses membership and everything paid in (第十一條 講員ノ資格ヲ失ヒ既掛込金ハ全部沒收).

name: 昭和御大典記念講
place_as_printed: 福岡縣築上郡東吉富村

notes: Decision sits with the membership in three clauses: officers are elected by the members and replaced the same way (第十八條 本講ノ事務ヲ處理スル爲メ講員ノ互選ニ依リ理事五名ヲ選定ス 但缺員ヲ生シタルトキハ其都度互選ニ依リ補充ス); the rules change only by 講員半數以上ノ許決 (第二十一條); and no pot is auctioned without a quorum (第四條 出席講員過半數ニ達スルトキハ花籤及入札ヲ行フ). The 理事 run business, approve security (第十條) and keep the passbook (第十三條), under that mandate.

name: 親睦講
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, p. 67, 規約 藏元ノ任務 (4); p. 68, footnote 4)
notes: The one clause in the seventeen that I read most narrowly, and the cell rests on how it is parsed. 一、藏元掛返シ金遲滯ノ節ハ裁判所ニ申請スルコトアルヘシ 右ノ費用ハ被告ノ負擔タルハ勿論タリト雖モ講中一同出金ノ上取扱フコト、尤モ損害費用要求シ不足ヲ生シタルトキハ講員一同ノ負擔タルヘキコト. When a drawer (既諍取者) fails to pay his 掛返シ金 the 藏元 may sue; costs are the defendant's but are advanced by all; and 尤モ損害費用要求シ不足ヲ生シタルトキハ講員一同ノ負擔タルヘキコト — if, on claiming 損害費用, a shortfall remains, it falls on 講員一同. The drawer's own security is a registered mortgage on rice land (規約 item 6, RB3's ground), and suit is the step after it; so 講員一同 is the last bearer the instrument names (rule 2). WHY LOW: 損害費用 can be read as one compound ('the costs, as damages') or as two ('the damages and the costs'). On the first reading the shortfall is only unrecovered LITIGATION COSTS, which is not the unpaid residue this characteristic asks about, and the cell is .NR. The editor's footnote 4) glosses the clause as about costs only (これに要する費用は該既取者の負擔…裁判終了まで諸費用は一時講員一同が立替へる) and does not mention the 不足 sentence at all. I read 損害 as the unpaid 掛返シ金 because the clause opens on that default (藏元掛返シ金遲滯ノ節) and 損害 is not otherwise used for costs in these rules (they say 費用); the editor's gloss is not evidence against it, since he does not address the sentence. ALTERNATIVE, stated fairly: .NR, on the costs-only reading. Raised in answer 4.

name: 親睦講
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, p. 67, 規約 item 6, 藏元ノ任務 (1)
notes: 本講資金諍取者ハ前項ノ義務ヲ履行スル爲メ掛返シ金拾圓ニ對シ地價金壹圓宛（田地ニ限ル）ノ土地ヲ擔保トシ、抵當權ヲ設定シ登記濟ノ上諍取金ヲ受領スルモノトス (規約 item 6; footnote 3 地價は法定地價), and the 藏元 must obtain the registration (藏元ノ任務 (1) 一、藏元ハ諍取者ヨリ規定ノ登記ヲ取得スベシ). Rice land only, registered, at a stated cover ratio; no guarantor is required anywhere in the rules.

name: 親睦講
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, p. 67, 規約 藏元ノ任務 (4)
notes: The bearer of the shortfall is named (講員一同ノ負擔, see RD-test) and how it is divided is not: no pro-rata, per-share or equal rule. The costs are 講中一同出金 with no ratio either. 講員一同 is a set of bearers, not a division rule. Silence on the division.

name: 親睦講
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, p. 67, 規約 藏元ノ任務 (4)
notes: Rests on the same clause as RD-test, and is low for the same reason. On the reading taken there, each member bears a share of another drawer's unrecovered default (講員一同ノ負擔), which is exposure beyond his own contribution. On the costs-only reading the members still advance litigation costs (講中一同出金ノ上取扱フコト) and bear any unrecovered part of them, which is also an outlay beyond contribution, though a smaller one; so this cell survives the alternative reading of RD-test better than RD-test does. The two cells are not independent evidence.

name: 親睦講
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, p. 67, 規約 藏元ノ任務 (2), (4)
notes: Graduated sanctions, on both sides of the draw. A drawer who misses the deadline is dunned by the 世話掛 within five days and pays 延滯損害料 at 掛返シ金五拾圓ニ對シ日步拾錢 plus a 督促料 of 參拾五錢 a time; then suit (藏元掛返シ金遲滯ノ節ハ裁判所ニ申請スルコトアルヘシ) against a registered mortgage. Unwon members (rule 5, recorded here): 又未諍取者ニアリテハ前掛金沒收シ除名スルコトアルヘシ — forfeiture of what he has paid and expulsion.

name: 親睦講
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, pp. 66–67, 規約 items 3, 4, 8
notes: The fund is allocated in the general meeting: 本講資金融通使用セントスルモノハ毎年十一月十五日ノ總會ニ於テ總資本金一千五拾圓ノ內ヨリ口諍ヲ以テ順次諍下ヲ執行シ (規約 item 4), the kō meeting once a year as a 總會 (item 3). Officers are put forward for fixed terms: 本講會務ヲ整理セン爲メ藏元二名及世話掛一名ヲ推薦シ任務ヲ五ケ年トス (item 8; footnote 2 藏元は世話人又は講元); 推薦 does not say by whom. Medium: the 總會 is the place of allocation by auction, which is a decision rule over the fund, but no clause gives the meeting power to amend or to decide other questions.

name: 正利講親無金無盡
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, p. 69, 規約 第九, 第十一, 第十三, 第十四; pp. 69–70, 正利講金借用證書
notes: ADJUDICATED 2026-10-22 (records/RULINGS-residual-default-2026-10-22.md, ruling 3): value kept (deferred), confidence medium -> low. Only a clause about default itself can be `deferred`; 第十一 is such a clause, but it says the meeting decides about the non-performer, and that it also decides who bears the residue is an added reading. Note as first coded: The instrument sends default to the members' decision. Order of recourse: the drawer; then his 連帶保證人 (form: 若シ期限相違ノ節又ハ居處不定死亡事故不在ノ時ハ連帶保證人ハ本人ニ代リ速ニ辨償可仕候萬一辨償ノ義務ヲ果サヽル時ハ成規ノ御取計被成候共決シテ異議無之候), or a mortgage in their place (規約 第九); all of which is the drawer's own security and RB3's ground (rule 1; footnote 6 makes the guarantors persons the members accept, not members by belonging). Beyond that the rules name no bearer and say instead: 第十一、本講連中ニ於テ約定ヲ履行セザル者アル時ハ臨時會ヲ開キ協議ノ上決定スル事, decisions by majority (第十三 但シ此ノ場合ハ凡テ多數決ヲ以テ定ムル事) and binding (第十四). I code `deferred` because 第十一 is a clause about DEFAULT specifically, not a general power to amend the rules or decide 'necessary matters'; a general clause of that kind would not by itself be `deferred`. Medium, because 第十一 does not say that the meeting decides WHO BEARS the unpaid residue; it says the meeting decides about the non-performer, which could be read as deciding only what to do to him (his own liability, rule 4). ALTERNATIVE: .NR on that narrower reading. 第十一 also covers unwon members who stop paying (rule 5); recorded at CN3.

name: 正利講親無金無盡
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, p. 69, 規約 第九; pp. 69–70, 正利講金借用證書
notes: Surety OR property, at the drawer's option. 第九、本講取主ハ連中開濟ノ連帶保證人貳名ヲ連署シタル左記債券ヲ藏元ニ差出シ引配スル事、尤モ抵當權ヲ設定スル時ハ證人ヲ要セス; the form is the guarantors' version (連帶保證人連署ヲ以テ金借用證書差入候), and it also binds the parties to give a mortgage on demand if default threatens (尚期限中ト雖モ前約定不履行ノ恐アル時ハ一時ニ皆金之返濟若シクハ抵當權ノ設定ニ應ジ可申候). The vocabulary's `mixed` is property and surety TOGETHER; here they are alternatives (with property as a fallback on demand). Coded `mixed` at medium as the nearest value and raised in answer 4. ALTERNATIVE: `surety`, since the printed form is the surety version and property is only an option.

name: 正利講親無金無盡
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, p. 69, 規約 第一–第十四
notes: No rule distributes an unmet loss. 第六、鬮取高ハ正手取トシ前取主ノ返濟金ヲ差引キ殘額ヲ末人數ノ平等割トス divides the bid surplus equally among the undrawn (footnote 5 末は未取人); reading 平等割 there as the loss rule would be the surplus-for-loss substitution. 第十一 defers default to 協議 and states no division. Silence.

name: 正利講親無金無盡
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, p. 69, 規約 第九; pp. 69–70, 正利講金借用證書
notes: ADJUDICATED 2026-10-22 (records/RULINGS-residual-default-2026-10-22.md, ruling 2): 1 -> .NR. For a kō, LS3 is 1 by either of two routes: the association route (a member answers for other members' obligations) or the debtor route (a drawer is expressly liable beyond his pledge with his person or whole estate; precedents sea_loan LS3=1, bodemerij_amsterdam LS3=1). Here the drawer's pledge and/or sureties secure his own agreed repayment; no clause makes him liable beyond the pledge with his person or estate, and no clause makes a member answer for another's debt. A pledge or surety alone is .NR on the general question, not 1 and not 0 (bodemerij_amsterdam note); 0 would need a clause confining liability to the pledge (bottomry). The clauses read are those quoted in the note as first coded: Coded on house practice (ko_mitarai_mujin_1773): the drawer's guarantors, or his mortgaged property, answer for his debt, and the form accelerates the whole debt if default threatens (一時ニ皆金之返濟). Same definitional objection as at 第六講. The guarantors are persons the members accept (footnote 6), not stated to be members, so the stronger ground is not available.

name: 正利講親無金無盡
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, p. 69, 規約 第十, 第十一; pp. 69–70, 正利講金借用證書
notes: Sanctioned on both sides of the draw. Any member: 第十、本會期ニ金ヲ積マズ督促ヲ受クル者ハ毎回貳拾錢ノ督促料ヲ支拂フ事, and 第十一 (any 約定ヲ履行セザル者 goes before a 臨時會). For the unwon member (rule 5, recorded here) those are the stated sanctions. Drawers: guarantors pay at once, and if they fail 成規ノ御取計被成候共決シテ異議無之候 (form), with acceleration or a mortgage on demand if default threatens.

name: 正利講親無金無盡
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, p. 69, 規約 第八, 第十一, 第十三, 第十四
notes: The membership decides, by majority, on officers, rules and defaults: 第十三、藏元事故アリテ辭スルカ講中ノ協議ニヨリ改ムルコトヲ得、尚協議ニ依リ此ノ規約ヲ變更追加スルコトアルヘシ 但シ此ノ場合ハ凡テ多數決ヲ以テ定ムル事 (footnote 7 講中は連中と同じく加入者); 第十一 defaults go to a 臨時會 and 協議; 第十四 本講中ノ協議決定シタルコトハ堅ク相守リ違背セサル事. The single 藏元 (第八) holds the books and bonds and passes money, as the members' agent.

name: 蒲團講
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, p. 71, 講則 第一–第八
notes: Silent beyond the drawer's own security. A payout creates a debt (大掛, footnote 2 既取人の返掛金), so the cell applies; the bedding purpose does not make it .NA, since the pot is money and the 解說 says spending it on bedding is left to the member. The drawer's security is 會員中ヨリ保證人二名以上 (第六). Under rule 1 these are guarantors chosen for this loan, so RB3's ground, even though they must be members: liability attaches by signing, not by belonging. Nothing names a bearer once they fail.

name: 蒲團講
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, p. 71, 講則 第六
notes: 第六、落札者ハ會員中ヨリ保證人二名以上ヲ立テ證書ヲ提出スルコト. Two or more guarantors drawn from the membership, with a bond; no property is taken.

name: 蒲團講
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, p. 71, 講則 第一–第八
notes: No rule distributes an unmet loss. 第七、利益金ハ毎回親子割トス divides a surplus, by footnote 4) 未取人既取人を問はず平均割; reading it as a loss rule would be the surplus-for-loss substitution. Silence.

name: 蒲團講
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, p. 71, 講則 第六
notes: Members are made guarantors of other members' draws: 第六、落札者ハ會員中ヨリ保證人二名以上ヲ立テ證書ヲ提出スルコト. A member who signs is exposed beyond his own contribution for a debt that is not his. This is the stronger ground (ko_mochiyori_yutsu_1876's co-sealers), not the house-practice reading of a drawer's own security.

name: 蒲團講
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, p. 71, 講則 第三, 第六
notes: ADJUDICATED 2026-10-22 (records/RULINGS-residual-default-2026-10-22.md, ruling 1): .NR -> 1, medium. The rules require the drawer to give a bond or security for his repayment; a required bond or pledge is the rules' own instrument of compulsion, and the procedure of enforcement need not be restated for the cell to be 1. Medium because no consequence of non-payment is stated in words. Note as first coded: No consequence of non-payment is stated. 第三 掛金ハ會合ノ當日持參ノコト fixes the duty; 第六 takes guarantors and a 證書 from the drawer; nothing says what follows a failure to pay, for a drawn member or for an unwon one (rule 5: nothing to record). House practice reads security without a sanction clause as .NR (ko_mitarai_mujin_1773 CN3). ALTERNATIVE: 1, on the ground that a bond with two guarantors is compulsion by its nature.

name: 蒲團講
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, p. 71, 講則 第二, 第四, 第五, 第八
notes: The 會主 (footnote 1 講親) takes the first pot (第五), hosts the meeting (第八), fixes and notifies its time (第四 日時ハ其ノ都度會主ニ於テ通知ス) and receives notice of a member's wish to use his share otherwise (第二). Nothing says who decides over the fund beyond that. The 解說 calls the 親 むしろ會員の世話役, but that is the ministry's characterisation. Silence on the locus.

name: 富士石碑講
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, pp. 77–78, 第八條, 第十條, 第十三條, 第十六條, 第十七條; p. 79, 割濟金連帶借用之證
notes: Applies, and silent. Applicability: the payout is a stone monument, not cash, but the drawer then owes 掛戾金 (第十六條; footnotes 4–5), so a debt to the fund exists. Recourse runs: the drawer and his 連帶借用人三名以上 (第十條, 第十三條; the form 連帶債務者ノ內ニ於テ返金相成兼候時ハ三名ノ內壹名ニテモ引受ケ必ズ返金可仕候), RB3's ground; then suit by the 世話人, or assignment of the claim if they cannot sue: 第十六條 本講員ニシテ大掛トナリ掛戾金ヲ怠リタルトキハ世話人ニ於テ訴訟ヲ提起スル事能ハザル場合ハ、債權ヲ他ニ讓渡スルコトアルモ、債務者ニ於テ必ズ異議ナキモノトス; costs on the debtor (第十七條). Nothing names who bears what is still unpaid. DECISION POINT, stated fairly: 第八條 本講出金花ヲ第一回ヨリ第三回迄積立テ掛金延滯ノ爲費消シタル時ノ費用ニ充ツ sets up a reserve for when there is 費消 owing to arrears. It could be read as `fund`: the reserve absorbs what arrears consume. I read 費用 as expenses (the 解說 calls it 訴訟費用, which agrees, though I do not rest on the 解說), so the clause pays the cost of pursuing a defaulter, not the defaulted sum; on that reading the rules leave the residue unassigned. If the maintainer reads 第八條 as covering the shortfall itself, this cell moves to `fund` and LS1 to `residual-on-fund`.

name: 富士石碑講
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, p. 78, 第十條, 第十三條; p. 79, 割濟金連帶借用之證
notes: 第十條 落札人定マリタルトキハ別紙證書雛形ニ依リ連帶借用人三名以上ニテ受取ルモノトス; 第十三條 本講落札人ハ連帶借用人ヲ參名以上選ビ世話人ニ一應相談ノ上定ムルコト. The form makes them joint co-borrowers each liable for the whole: 連帶債務者ノ內ニ於テ返金相成兼候時ハ三名ノ內壹名ニテモ引受ケ必ズ返金可仕候. No property is taken. 連帶借用人 are co-debtors rather than sureties in form, but they are third parties chosen for this loan who answer for it, which is what `surety` records; there is no closer value.

name: 富士石碑講
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, pp. 77–78, 第一條–第十七條
notes: No rule distributes an unmet loss among members. 第八條's reserve pays 費用 (see RD-test for the alternative reading under which this cell would be `residual-on-fund`). Silence.

name: 富士石碑講
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, p. 78, 第十條, 第十三條, 第十六條; p. 79, 割濟金連帶借用之證
notes: ADJUDICATED 2026-10-22 (records/RULINGS-residual-default-2026-10-22.md, ruling 2): 1 -> .NR. For a kō, LS3 is 1 by either of two routes: the association route (a member answers for other members' obligations) or the debtor route (a drawer is expressly liable beyond his pledge with his person or whole estate; precedents sea_loan LS3=1, bodemerij_amsterdam LS3=1). Here the drawer's pledge and/or sureties secure his own agreed repayment; no clause makes him liable beyond the pledge with his person or estate, and no clause makes a member answer for another's debt. A pledge or surety alone is .NR on the general question, not 1 and not 0 (bodemerij_amsterdam note); 0 would need a clause confining liability to the pledge (bottomry). The clauses read are those quoted in the note as first coded: Coded on house practice (ko_mitarai_mujin_1773): the drawer and his three co-borrowers answer jointly for his 掛戾金 and the claim may be sued on or sold (第十六條). Same definitional objection as at 第六講. The rules do not say the 連帶借用人 must be members, so the stronger ground is not available.

name: 富士石碑講
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, p. 78, 第十四條, 第十六條, 第十七條; p. 79, 割濟金連帶借用之證
notes: Sanctioned on both sides of the draw. Penalty interest: 第十四條 本講掛金ハ開會月內ニ出金セハ無利子ナルモ、翌月ニ渡ル時ハ翌日ヨリ日步百圓ニ付四錢ヲ徵收スルコト. Drawers: suit or sale of the claim (第十六條), costs on the debtor (第十七條), and in the form acceleration of the whole (割濟ノ契約ヲ取消シ壹時ニ全額ヲ辨濟可仕候). Unwon members (rule 5, recorded here): 第十六條 小掛者タリトモ掛込金ヲ怠リタルトキハ競賣スルコトアルベシ — his share may be sold (footnote 6 未取者の持口を他に賣ること).

name: 富士石碑講
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, pp. 77–78, 第二條, 第七條, 第十一條, 第十五條
notes: The fund is handled by officers: 第七條 本講金取扱ハ世話人ニ於テ扱フモノトシ、世話人四名及ビ取締人一名ヲ置クコトトス; they pay the 會主 (第十一條), are consulted on the choice of co-borrowers (第十三條) and on transfers (第十五條). The 會主 is named in the rules (第二條 本講會主ヲ甲野丙吉ト定メ) as the maker and seller of the steles. How officers are chosen and who decides over the fund are not stated. ALTERNATIVE: `external-administered`, if the 會主 (an outside supplier, on the 解說's account) is taken to run the kō; rejected because the rules give him the meeting and the sale, and the money to the 世話人.

name: 加茂川原昭和講
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, p. 82, 會則 items 7, 10; 年賦金借用證書
notes: Silent beyond the drawer's own security. The drawer gives a bond with 貳名以上ノ連帶債務者 who must be 世帶主又ハ講員 (會則 item 10). Under rule 1 they are security chosen for this loan, RB3's ground, even when they are members: they bind by signing. The form gives the creditor every remedy against the signatories (如何ナル御處分ニ及フモ異議申間敷…殘額及ヒ費用等一時ニ御取立下サレ度候) and names nobody after them. 會則 item 11 (總テ本講ハ共力一致シテ…御互ヒニ德義ヲ以テ本講ノ目的ヲ達成センコトヲ契約ス) is an exhortation, not a rule on who bears an unpaid residue; reading it as `all-members` would turn a statement of purpose into a liability clause. Applicability: payout creates a debt (form: 毎定日壹回ニ付キ金拾五圓宛必ラズ返濟可致候).

name: 加茂川原昭和講
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, p. 82, 會則 item 10; 年賦金借用證書
notes: 一、落札者ハ落札セシ次回ヨリ終回ニ致ル掛金ノ辨濟證書ヲ貳名以上ノ連帶債務者ヲ以テ作製ノ上落札金ノ給付ヲ受クルモノトス、但シ連帶債務者ハ世帶主又ハ講員タルコト (item 10). The form is a joint bond (右金額我等連帶ニテ借用候處實證也). No property is taken. Joint co-debtors chosen for this loan; `surety` is the value for third parties standing behind the drawer.

name: 加茂川原昭和講
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, pp. 81–82, 會則 items 1–11
notes: No rule distributes an unmet loss. 一、糶金ハ口數ニ平等ニ分配ス (item 9; footnote 4 糶金は入札差金) divides the bid surplus; it is not a loss rule. Silence.

name: 加茂川原昭和講
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, p. 82, 會則 item 10; 年賦金借用證書
notes: A member may be bound for another's draw: the co-debtors must be 世帶主又ハ講員 (item 10), and they are jointly liable for the whole remaining 年賦金 and costs (form: 殘額及ヒ費用等一時ニ御取立下サレ度候). Medium because 又ハ makes membership one option, not a requirement; where the co-debtors are household heads outside the kō, the ground falls back to house practice (the drawer's own bond answering for his debt).

name: 加茂川原昭和講
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, p. 82, 會則 item 7; 年賦金借用證書
notes: Any member who does not pay on the day is fined: 一、掛金ハ壹口金拾五圓トシ毎定日ニ會場迄持參拂込ムモノトス、但シ當日不拂者ハ過滯金五拾錢宛申受クルモノトス (item 7); for an unwon member (rule 5, recorded here) that fine is the only stated sanction. For a drawer, one missed date opens every remedy and accelerates the debt: 若シ一定日ニ於テ返金出來兼ネ候節ハ我等ニ對シ如何ナル御處分ニ及フモ異議申間敷其ノ場合ニ於テハ當時ノ返金額ハ勿論殘額及ヒ費用等一時ニ御取立下サレ度候 (form).

name: 加茂川原昭和講
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, p. 81, 會則 items 1, 3
notes: The kō is 加茂川原煙草耕作組合ノ主催 (item 1) and run day to day by 世話人四名 who 講ノ事務ヲ掌リ (item 3). How the 世話人 are chosen, and whether the 組合 has any power over the fund, are not stated. ALTERNATIVE: `external-administered`, reading 主催 as administration by a body outside the subscribing members. Rejected on two grounds: 主催 says the 組合 sponsors the kō, not that it decides over the fund; and on the 解說's account the members are themselves 組合員, so the 組合 is not clearly outside the subscribing body. Silence on the locus.

name: 吉武信用貯金講會
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, p. 93, 規則 第九條 (as amended 昭和九年); p. 88, 第七條; pp. 94–95, 金借用證書 items 五, 九
notes: LOW, and the cell turns on one phrase. Amended 第九條 makes every drawer deposit a reserve against arrears: 本講會當籤者ハ貸付ヲ受クル際本講會掛不足整理費トシテ金參圓ヲ講會ニ供託シ置クモノトス、此押ヘ金ハ整理費ヲ控除シ殘金ハ滿會ノ際會員平等ニ分配スルモノトス, and the interest on the kō's deposits 押ヘ金ト見做シ講會費用ニ備ヘ. The drawer's own security comes first and is RB3's ground: property (第七條) and 連帶保證人 who answer as independent debtors (金借用證書 item 九 連帶保證人ハ…獨立ノ債務ヲ負擔シタルモノト看做シ其ノ履行ノ責ニ任シ可申候). After that the only provision for 掛不足 is the 押ヘ金 reserve, so on my reading the fund absorbs the shortfall and the remainder is shared out at the end. WHY LOW: 掛不足整理費 can be read as a charge for the expense of clearing up arrears, not as money that makes the arrears good; on that reading the clause is a costs clause and the cell is .NR. I read it as the latter because its object is 掛不足 itself, not 訴訟 or 費用 in general. TWO FURTHER DECISION POINTS. (i) The same 第九條 says 講會加盟者ニシテ掛込金ヲ怠リタルトキハ未取者（子）ハ本人ノ本會ニ於ケル抽籤權ヲ除キ取親（親）ナルトキハ其部落加盟者全部ノ抽籤權ヲ除クモノトス: when a drawer (footnote 2) defaults, every member of his 部落 loses his right to draw. That is a sanction that falls on a standing group by belonging, which is the rule-1 test for `standing-subgroup`, but it makes no one liable for the sum; I record it here and do not code it as the bearer. ALTERNATIVE: `standing-subgroup`, if collective pressure by belonging is read as the answer to 'who bears it'. (ii) The 解說's 實際には概ね部落保證を徵してゐる would support `standing-subgroup` in practice; it is the ministry's account, not the rules, and is not used. LS1 = residual-on-fund rests on the same clause; the two cells are one fact.

name: 吉武信用貯金講會
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, p. 88, 規則 第七條; pp. 94–95, 金借用證書 items 五, 九
notes: Property and surety together. 第七條 本講金貸與ヲ受ケタルモノハ貸付金ノ三分ノ一ノ地價ヲ有スル田、畑、山林、貸付金ト同額ノ地價ヲ有スル宅地、貸付金ノ一倍半ノ時價ヲ有スル有價證券又ハ貸付金ト同額以上ノ吉武信用購買販賣利用組合ノ貯金證券ヲ担保トシテ提供スベシ 但シ支配方ニ於テ適當ト認メタル場合ハ三人以上ノ連帶保證人アル場合ニ限リ前記担保ヲ供セズシテ貸付スルコトアルベシ (footnote 3: 地價は法定地價). The 金借用證書 that every borrower signs carries 連帶保證人 (six signature lines), who must be replaced if they lose 資力又ハ信用 (item 五) and who answer as independent debtors (item 九). So the ordinary case is property plus sureties, with sureties alone (three or more) by the 支配方's dispensation. `mixed` carries both mixtures (several kinds of property, and property plus surety).

name: 吉武信用貯金講會
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, p. 93, 規則 第九條 (as amended 昭和九年)
notes: ONE CLAUSE, TWO CELLS: this cell and RD-test = fund rest on the same words, as RD-TEST-DEFINITION.md requires. Amended 第九條: 本講會當籤者ハ貸付ヲ受クル際本講會掛不足整理費トシテ金參圓ヲ講會ニ供託シ置クモノトス、此押ヘ金ハ整理費ヲ控除シ殘金ハ滿會ノ際會員平等ニ分配スルモノトス. On my reading arrears are met from the 押ヘ金 reserve, and what is left is divided equally at the end. Low for the reason stated at RD-test: if 整理費 means only the cost of dealing with arrears, there is no loss rule and the cell is .NR. ALTERNATIVE: `equal`, on the ground that a loss absorbed by the reserve reduces each member's equal share of what is returned at 滿會 (會員平等ニ分配). Rejected because the clause allocates what is LEFT of the reserve, not the loss; the loss stops at the reserve. Beyond the reserve the rules are silent.

name: 吉武信用貯金講會
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, p. 88, 規則 第七條; pp. 94–95, 金借用證書 items 六, 九
notes: ADJUDICATED 2026-10-22 (records/RULINGS-residual-default-2026-10-22.md, ruling 2): 1 -> .NR. For a kō, LS3 is 1 by either of two routes: the association route (a member answers for other members' obligations) or the debtor route (a drawer is expressly liable beyond his pledge with his person or whole estate; precedents sea_loan LS3=1, bodemerij_amsterdam LS3=1). Here the drawer's pledge and/or sureties secure his own agreed repayment; no clause makes him liable beyond the pledge with his person or estate, and no clause makes a member answer for another's debt. A pledge or surety alone is .NR on the general question, not 1 and not 0 (bodemerij_amsterdam note); 0 would need a clause confining liability to the pledge (bottomry). The clauses read are those quoted in the note as first coded: Coded on house practice (ko_mitarai_mujin_1773): the drawer's land, securities or 組合 savings certificates and his 連帶保證人 answer for his debt, with acceleration on attachment, auction, bankruptcy or 'harm to the 組合's claim' (金借用證書 item 六 左ノ場合ニハ期限內ト雖モ貴組合ノ御請求次第即時元利金返濟可致候). Definitional objection as at the first kō coded: what is secured is the repayment he agreed to. The guarantors are not required to be members, so the stronger ground is not available. NOTE: the 金借用證書 is addressed to 貴組合 (the 組合), which is not the kō; whether the debt is owed to the kō or to the 組合 is not settled by the rules, and this matters for RD-test's applicability. I take it as a debt to the kō because 第六條 says the kō lends (本講會ヨリ貸付シタル金員) and the loan application is addressed to 吉武信用講支配人.

name: 吉武信用貯金講會
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, p. 93, 規則 第九條 (as amended); pp. 94–95, 金借用證書 items 四, 六, 七
notes: Sanctioned on both sides of the draw. Unwon members (rule 5, recorded here): under amended 第九條 an undrawn member who fails to pay loses his own right to draw at the 本會 (未取者（子）ハ本人ノ本會ニ於ケル抽籤權ヲ除キ). The unamended text was harsher: 加盟者ニ於テ掛込金ヲ爲サヾルトキハ本講會員ヲ除名シ殘加盟者ニ於テ其掛込權利ヲ競賣ニ附シ落札金ハ本講會ノ所得トス (p. 88), superseded from 昭和九年二月八日. Drawers: penalty damages from the day after default (金借用證書 item 四 支拂遲滯致候節ハ期日ノ翌日ヨリ損害金トシテ…賠償可致候), acceleration (item 六), costs of suit including counsel on the borrower (item 七), sureties as independent debtors (item 九), and the 部落-wide suspension of draw rights (amended 第九條).

name: 吉武信用貯金講會
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, p. 93, 規則 第二條 (as amended); p. 88, 第五條, 第七條; p. 89, 第十三條; p. 93, 第九條
notes: The fund is run, ex officio, by officers of another body. Amended 第二條: 本講會ニ支配人及監査人ヲ置キ支配人ハ吉武信用購買販賣利用組合ノ理事部長是ニ當リ本講會ノ進行事務ヲ司リ監査人ハ同組合ノ監事是ニ當リ本講會全部ニ亘リ監査ヲナスモノトス (the unamended text had 支配方ハ…組合理事是レニ當リ). The 支配方 judge security and may waive it (第七條), the draw is held 支配方、監査人立會ノ上 (第五條), the kō's money is deposited in the 組合 (amended 第九條), and loans go first to pay debts owed to the 組合 (第六條 本講會ヨリ貸付シタル金員ハ先ヅ第一ニ吉武信用購買販賣利用組合ニ對スル債務ノ辨濟ニ充當シ). Against this, the members amend the rules: 第十三條 本講々則ノ變更ハ會員ノ半數以上ノ同意アルコトヲ要ス. Medium for two reasons: (i) that is a collective decision rule, and the ALTERNATIVE is `collective`; I code the body that decides over the fund day to day rather than the body that may change the rules; (ii) the 組合 is not wholly outside the subscribing body, since many members are 組合員 (第三條 as amended), though the officers are appointed by their office in the 組合, not chosen by the kō. The 解說 calls the kō 獨立の全く別個のもの; the rules say otherwise about who runs it, and I code the rules.

name: 岡龍無盡
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, pp. 98–99, 第四條, 第五條, 第七條, 第八條, 第十條, 第十五條; p. 99, 玄米借用證
notes: Applies, and silent beyond the drawer's own security. The payout (rice) creates a debt: the form binds the drawer to 毎年拾壹月廿九日參等玄米壹俵宛滿會迄無遲滯返米. His security is 連帶保證人 (第四條), two of them where he also pledges land or a 信用組合 deposit certificate (第五條), and for the 講親 a 宿保證人 (第十五條; footnote 10 宿保證人は講親保證人をいふ); all RB3's ground. The form adds the guarantors' undertaking that the members will not suffer: 萬一壹回タリトモ相滯候節ハ連帶者ハ本人ニ成リ替リ聊モ御連中ニハ御迷惑相懸申間敷候. That says who must NOT bear the loss (御連中), not who bears it if the guarantors fail, so it is not `all-members` and is not `fund`. 第七條 gives the 世話人 出訴ノ權 against 不掛ノ者; 第八條 puts costs of suit on the defaulter (rule 4); 第十條 keeps 毎回金壹圓 for 臨時費又ハ訴訟費用 — a reserve for costs, not for the defaulted rice. Nothing names a bearer beyond the guarantors.

name: 岡龍無盡
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, p. 98, 第四條, 第五條; p. 99, 第十五條, 玄米借用證
notes: Surety always, property in addition. 第四條 取入主ハ自己ニ對スル保證人ヲ前以テ豫メ定メ置キ取入ノ節不都合ナキ樣可致事 但連帶保證人無キ爲メ取入兼候トキハ次會ヨリ五ケ年間鬮札入ルヽ事ヲ不得; 第五條 取入者ニシテ抵當ヲ差出シタル者ハ保證人貳名トス 但未掛米ニ對スル田ハ五畝步、畑宅地ハ未掛米拾俵ニ對スル地價金五圓トス 信用組合ノ預金證ハ金貳百圓ト定ム. The form 玄米借用證 takes 此爲抵當平澤町信用購買販賣利用組合ノ…預金證書壹通 (又ハ) … 田、畑、宅地 何段何畝何步 and is signed by 落取主 and 保證人. The 講親's own performance is guaranteed by a 宿保證人 (第十五條).

name: 岡龍無盡
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, p. 98, 第十條, 第十一條
notes: No rule distributes an unmet loss. 第十條 臨時費又ハ訴訟費用等ニ要スルタメ毎回金壹圓宛積置キ餘金ハ滿會ノ節一同配分スルモノトス divides what is left of a costs reserve; 第十一條 takes 配當金 from the 鬮餘リ米 (footnote 6). Neither is a loss rule.

name: 岡龍無盡
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, p. 98, 第四條, 第五條; p. 99, 玄米借用證
notes: ADJUDICATED 2026-10-22 (records/RULINGS-residual-default-2026-10-22.md, ruling 2): 1 -> .NR. For a kō, LS3 is 1 by either of two routes: the association route (a member answers for other members' obligations) or the debtor route (a drawer is expressly liable beyond his pledge with his person or whole estate; precedents sea_loan LS3=1, bodemerij_amsterdam LS3=1). Here the drawer's pledge and/or sureties secure his own agreed repayment; no clause makes him liable beyond the pledge with his person or estate, and no clause makes a member answer for another's debt. A pledge or surety alone is .NR on the general question, not 1 and not 0 (bodemerij_amsterdam note); 0 would need a clause confining liability to the pledge (bottomry). The clauses read are those quoted in the note as first coded: Coded on house practice (ko_mitarai_mujin_1773): the drawer's land or deposit certificate and his guarantors answer for his rice debt. Definitional objection as at the first kō coded: what is secured is the repayment he agreed to. The guarantors are not required to be members, so the stronger ground is not available.

name: 岡龍無盡
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, p. 98, 第四條, 第七條, 第八條, 第九條
notes: Sanctioned on both sides of the draw. Drawers: suit by the 世話人 (第七條 不掛ノ者有ル節ハ出訴ノ權ヲ擔當可致), with all costs on the defaulter (第八條 取入者ニシテ不掛ノタメ訴訟ノ節ハ訴訟費用ハ勿論世話人若クハ代理人ノ旅費日當共一切不掛者ニ於テ負擔可致者トス), and guarantors who stand in his place (form). Unwon members (rule 5, recorded here): 第九條 不取ノ者ニシテ二回不掛致シタル者ハ掛詰メ米返米不致シテ除名可致事 — expulsion with forfeiture of the rice paid in (footnote 4). A would-be drawer who cannot find a guarantor is barred from bidding for five years (第四條 但書).

name: 岡龍無盡
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, pp. 98–99, 第六條, 第十四條, 第十六條, 第十七條
notes: The membership elects the officers, controls transfers and changes the rules by majority. 第六條 證券名宛人壹名、證券預リ人壹名、世話人參名選擧ヲ以テ決定ス; 第十四條 transfer 連中ノ承諾ヲ得タル (footnote 9 講員(連中)の承認); 第十六條 本無盡會則ハ連中協議ノ上變更スル事アルベシ; 第十七條 本無盡會則ハ連中過半數ヲ以テ取極メタル條件ニ付後日不服ヲ唱フル事ヲ得ス. The 世話人 run the business and hold the right to sue (第七條) under that mandate.

name: 根津忠一郎企米無盡
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, p. 106, 第四條–第七條
notes: Applies, and silent beyond the drawer's own security. The draw is a loan of rice (第四條 積米ノ貸付), so it creates a debt. The drawer gives 戸主三名以上ノ保證アル證書 (第四條), RB3's ground. On default: 第六條 鬮取人ニ於テ掛米ヲ延滯シタルトキハ藏元ハ評議員會ノ決議ニ依リ正當ノ手續ニ依リ之レヲ徵收スルモノトス、此ノ場合ニ於ケル一切ノ費用ハ鬮取人ノ負擔トス (footnote 7: 鬮取人 = 既取人) — collection and costs against the defaulter himself (rule 4). The rules name no bearer once that fails. NOT TO BE MISREAD: 第七條 makes all members take over an expelled member's share (該株ニ對スル一切ノ權利義務ヲ加入者一同ニテ繼承スル), which would be `all-members` if it applied to drawn members; but it applies to 生株者 (footnote 8: 未取者), so it is an unwon member's default and belongs to CN3 under rule 5. Recorded there. 第五條's 差額米ハ落札者ニ於テ負擔 is a winner who fails to give his bond (rule 4).

name: 根津忠一郎企米無盡
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, p. 106, 第四條
notes: 第四條 鬮取リニ依リ積米ノ貸付ヲ受ケントスルモノハ戸主三名以上ノ保證アル證書ヲ藏元ニ差出シ承認ヲ經タル後貸付ヲ受クルモノトス 但シ藏元ニ於テ必要アリト認メタルトキハ證人ノ定數ヲ增減セシムルコトヲ得. Three or more household heads as guarantors, the number adjustable by the 藏元 (footnote 5: 役員、世話人); no property is taken.

name: 根津忠一郎企米無盡
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, pp. 106–107, 第一條–第十條
notes: No rule distributes an unmet loss on a drawn member's default. 第七條's 加入者一同ニテ繼承 is the one place where members collectively take on a defaulter's obligations, and it is an unwon member's share (see RD-test and CN3); it states who takes it over, not how it is divided among them, and it does not concern a loss after the pool is exhausted. Silence.

name: 根津忠一郎企米無盡
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, p. 106, 第七條
notes: Members are exposed beyond their own agreed contribution for another member's obligations: 第七條 生株者掛米ヲ延滯シタルトキハ會ノ決議ニ依リ之ヲ除名ス、此場合ニ於テハ該株ニ對スル一切ノ權利義務ヲ加入者一同ニテ繼承スルモノトス 除名ヲ受ケタルモノ、既納掛米ハ無盡終了後之ヲ返付ス. When an undrawn member is expelled, the remaining members inherit his share's duties, including its remaining contributions and the refund of what he paid in. This is a direct, articulated exposure, not the house-practice reading of a drawer's own security; the 戸主 who guarantee drawers (第四條) are not said to be members, so they are not relied on here.

name: 根津忠一郎企米無盡
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, p. 106, 第四條, 第六條, 第七條
notes: Sanctioned on both sides of the draw. Drawers: collection 正當ノ手續ニ依リ on the 評議員會's decision, costs on the drawer (第六條), against three household-head guarantors (第四條). Unwon members (rule 5, recorded here): 第七條 生株者掛米ヲ延滯シタルトキハ會ノ決議ニ依リ之ヲ除名ス — expulsion by decision of the meeting; his share's rights and duties pass to 加入者一同, and the rice he paid in is returned only after the kō ends (既納掛米ハ無盡終了後之ヲ返付ス).

name: 根津忠一郎企米無盡
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, pp. 106–107, 第六條, 第七條, 第八條, 第十條
notes: Officers are chosen by the general meeting and act on the meeting's or council's decisions. 第十條 本會ニ藏元二名評議員三名ヲ置キ總會ニ於テ之ヲ定ム 藏元ハ本會ノ業務一切ノ取締ニ當ル 評議員ハ藏元ノ業務ヲ應援ス; collection against a defaulting drawer is on the 評議員會ノ決議 (第六條); expulsion of an unwon member is by 會ノ決議 (第七條); a transfer needs 會員一同ノ承認 (第八條). The 企人 (footnote 4: 講親) hosts the meetings (第三條) and takes a fee from each drawer (第九條), with no stated decision power.

name: 愛宕社講
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, p. 118, 第五條; pp. 118–119, 割濟米連帶借用之證
notes: Applies, and silent beyond the drawer's own security. The shrine levy (第三條) does not make the kō a pure donation scheme: the pot is drawn by a member (第五條) and repaid in instalments (form: 割濟), so a debt to the fund exists. Security: 落札人ハ連借證書ニテ猶ホ堅固ナル事ヲ計リ世話人指名ノ連借四名記載スル事 (第五條), co-borrowers named by the 世話人, which is RB3's ground (rule 1). The form makes them answer one for all: 萬一連帶債務者ノ內ニ於テ返米相成兼候時ハ參名ノ內誰彼ヲ問ハズ一名ニテモ引受必ズ返米可仕候聊タリ共御損毛相懸申間敷候. That promises the 世話人 no loss; it does not say who bears it if the co-borrowers fail. Nothing in the 講則 does.

name: 愛宕社講
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, p. 118, 第五條; pp. 118–119, 割濟米連帶借用之證
notes: 第五條 本講ハ鬮講トシ最低ノ一本籤トシ、落札人ハ連借證書ニテ猶ホ堅固ナル事ヲ計リ世話人指名ノ連借四名記載スル事 但シ落札米ハ證書引替ノ事. No property is taken. A DISCREPANCY IN THE INSTRUMENT, recorded and not resolved: the 講則 require four co-borrowers (連借四名), the form provides three 連帶借用主 lines and speaks of 參名ノ內. Whether the drawer counts as one of the four is not stated. The value does not depend on it.

name: 愛宕社講
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, p. 118, 第五條; pp. 118–119, 割濟米連帶借用之證
notes: ADJUDICATED 2026-10-22 (records/RULINGS-residual-default-2026-10-22.md, ruling 2): 1 -> .NR. For a kō, LS3 is 1 by either of two routes: the association route (a member answers for other members' obligations) or the debtor route (a drawer is expressly liable beyond his pledge with his person or whole estate; precedents sea_loan LS3=1, bodemerij_amsterdam LS3=1). Here the drawer's pledge and/or sureties secure his own agreed repayment; no clause makes him liable beyond the pledge with his person or estate, and no clause makes a member answer for another's debt. A pledge or surety alone is .NR on the general question, not 1 and not 0 (bodemerij_amsterdam note); 0 would need a clause confining liability to the pledge (bottomry). The clauses read are those quoted in the note as first coded: Coded on house practice (ko_mitarai_mujin_1773): the drawer and his co-borrowers answer jointly for his rice debt, accelerated on a single default (割濟ノ契約ヲ取消一時ニ全額ヲ辨濟可仕候). Definitional objection as at the first kō coded. The 連借 are named by the 世話人 and are not said to be members (the rules' word for members is 連名, footnote 5), so the stronger ground is not available.

name: 愛宕社講
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, pp. 118–119, 割濟米連帶借用之證
notes: The consequence of a drawer's default is stated in the form: 若期日ニ到リ壹回タリトモ相滯候節ハ割濟ノ契約ヲ取消一時ニ全額ヲ辨濟可仕候, the co-borrowers answer one for all, and suit is contemplated (該債務不履行ノ爲メ訴訟ヲ提起スル場合ハ貴殿所在地ヲ管轄スル裁判所ヲ以テ裁判籍トナル事ヲ承諾仕候). Unwon members (rule 5): nothing stated beyond the duty to bring rice (第三條, 第八條); no sanction for a 小掛 who stops paying. Medium because the sanction is only in the form, and only for drawers.

name: 愛宕社講
source_ref: 農林省經濟更生部 1936, p. 118, 第五條, 第六條, 第七條, 第十條
notes: The members amend the rules by majority, subject to the 世話人's consent: 第十條 右講則中改正ノ必要アリト認メタル時ハ連名半數以上ノ決議ニヨリ世話人ノ承諾ヲ經テ變更スル事ヲ得 (footnote 5 連名は加入者の意). Day to day the two 世話人 attend in turn (第六條) and name the co-borrowers (第五條); 檢査役 rotate among the members in roll order (第七條; footnote 6). Medium: the 世話人 hold a veto over amendment, and how they are chosen is not stated. ALTERNATIVE: .NR, reading a member majority subject to an officer's consent as no fitting value.
